# Regression test for the textarea value-update path.
#
# textarea(value=expr) and input(value=expr) must:
#   1. SetText with the value at BuildUI time (not just for bindTarget binds).
#   2. Re-sync the entry text whenever any var the value depends on changes.
#
# Reactivity flows through the shared NoReactivity lowering pass: every
# Assign that mutates a tracked Var has explicit `m.entry0.SetText(...)`
# updates spliced after it, so we look for that inline form rather than
# the older per-widget updateEntry0 method.
#
# SetText takes the value unwrapped: the Entry intrinsic declares `text
# string`, so a caller converts and no fmt.Sprint is emitted around it.

sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# Init: SetText is emitted at BuildUI time for the textarea's value.
# Post-Plan-C widget ids use the lowered __nN scheme rather than per-tag
# counters; textarea is __n0 (vbox is __n1, button is __n2).
grep 'm\.__n0\.SetText\(m\.content\)' out/model.go

# Reactive update spliced into the button's @click handler by the
# NoReactivity lowering pass (button is __n2). Asserted as the assignment
# followed by the re-sync, because the re-sync is spelled identically to the
# BuildUI-time SetText above -- a grep for it alone would pass on that one and
# claim 2 would go untested.
grep 'm\.content = "after click"\n\tm\.__n0\.SetText\(m\.content\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

output {
    go { fyne }
}

component main {
    var content = "initial value"

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            textarea(value=content, rows=4)
            button(text="set", @click { content = "after click" })
        }
    }
}
